text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"I dedicate my entire being to guiding
one and all to an ideal world. To assure
people that I can see my goal through,
'strength' is but the minimum 
requirement."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Wow, President Rudolf! Can she be any
cooler?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
She's got brains, beauty,
and to top it all off,
strength! Everyone knows how
amazing she is. No one could doubt
otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
She runs so effortlessly—no wonder
people
admire her. I wonder how I can
be like her?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? "Lately I've taken to visiting
museums to
cultivate my senses." You
don't say...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, at the museum...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Hrnh? Wh-what's going on in this
painting? I
don't get it!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
One person's garden of delights is another
person's mystery. "I don't get it"
is a perfectly
normal reaction to this
particular triptych.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Eek! P-President Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
How serendipitous. I didn't know you
also had an
interest in Western art,
Tsuyoshi.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Um, no! You see, I read an article
about you
recently that said you
enjoyed visiting museums!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I figured if I tried doing the same thing,
then
maybe I could be as cool as you...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I see. Well, thank you. I'm
humbled by the
bedazzling purity of
your heart.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Be... what now? Thanks? I think?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
But paintings sure aren't easy to
understand. Right now, the only things I
know are the artist
and the year the
piece was painted.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm. How about I explain the paintings
to you,
then? Think of me as your
personal museum tour
guide!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
You'd really do that?! I mean, I don't
want to take
up your free time...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, I can't ignore someone who looks
up to me as "cool." I may not be as
informed as a curator, but if that's all
right with you, I'm happy to
oblige.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Wh-wh-whoa! Of course I wouldn't mind!
I'm
looking forward to our tour!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Good. Let's start with this piece, then.
It's one of
the artist's iconic works and is
packed with symbolic meaning. If you
look to the rightmost panel...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for today!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Your explanations were super easy to
follow. I
learned a lot!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea you were so
knowledgeable about
paintings! You
really are amazing!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
All I did was mention details that came
to mind.
You were an excellent listener,
so I had fun too.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure that you could talk about
any
topic under the sun and people
would stop to
listen!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
By the way, are you heading back to the
academy
now? If you are, I was
wondering if we could...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, I'm stopping by the drugstore first.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: What?! Are you feeling sick?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No. It's just that student council
business has
been piling up lately, so I wanted to
get some vitamin drinks to shore up my
defenses.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Lately? I feel like you're always going
nonstop.
Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Um! If it's a vitamin drink you need,
then... I can
make one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, on campus...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so this is the "Tsuyoshi Special
Elixir"
you
mentioned.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's got plum, lemon, pickled
mackerel​... It's
packed with ingredients
that work wonders to
restore energy!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I don't exactly have the hardiest
constitution, so I did my own research
and came up with a drink that works for
me. That's one of my most effective
brews!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Word of warning, though—I tend to
focus on what works over what's tasty. I
tried adapting the drink
for you, but it
might still be...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Whoa! You're really gulping it down!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Uh! So, h-how is it?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...You put extra honey in it for me,
didn't
you? It
tastes good. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Still, you created this all by yourself?
The flavor
profile is complex... I can tell
you put a lot of ingredients into it.
Would you mind sharing your recipe?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Oh! Uh, no! Of course not!
